reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval
scope: Five product-information reviews expired seven days after 16 September 17:44:34Z. These are separate from the twelve reviews released through PRs #795/#796. sources.assessment: Sections 4.1 and 4.2 retain adult weight management with dietary and activity changes and weekly injection. The paediatric type 2 diabetes indication is separate. Sections 4.4, 4.5 and 4.8 document assessment needs, interactions, gastrointestinal effects and serious cautions; section 5.1 supports GIP/GLP-1 appetite effects. The bounded Watch summary remains supported. No NHS funding or individual pharmacy-stock conclusion follows from this SmPC.

Sections 4.1 and 4.2 support adult weight management and daily oral use. Fasting and post-dose waiting requirements, variable absorption and specific switching instructions support the existing administration and non-interchangeability cautions. Sections 4.4, 4.5 and 4.8 retain gastrointestinal effects and other safety/interaction warnings; section 5.1 supports GLP-1 appetite action. This document does not establish NHS access or stock.

Xenical remains a prescription-only 120 mg orlistat product. Sections 4.1 and 4.2 support eligible weight management with dietary changes and meal-related dosing. Sections 4.4, 4.5 and 4.8 support gastrointestinal, medicine-interaction and fat-soluble-vitamin cautions; section 5.1 supports reduced dietary fat absorption. Conditions of use differ from the 60 mg pharmacy product. No supply guarantee or new NHS eligibility claim is made.

alli remains a pharmacy 60 mg orlistat product. Sections 4.1 and 4.2 support adult weight loss with a reduced-calorie, lower-fat diet, meal-related use and different eligibility/duration conditions from prescription 120 mg. Sections 4.3 to 4.5 and 4.8 retain contraindications, interactions, vitamin absorption and digestive effects. Section 5.1 supports gastrointestinal lipase inhibition. Existing bounded wording needs no change; pharmacy classification is not proof of stock.

Sections 4.1 and 4.2 support adult weight management, a separate type 2 diabetes indication and daily oral tablets. Sections 4.4, 4.5 and 4.8 retain clinical assessment, interaction and gastrointestinal-safety considerations. Section 5.1 supports non-peptide GLP-1 receptor action and distinguishes trial capsules from marketed tablets, which are not mg-for-mg substitutes. The Watch gives no dose advice and needs no wording change. NHS access and private supply remain separately evidenced.
